verdict.rationale: Runway is a generative creative platform, so surfacing AI insights or suggestions from a user's data is a fair question, but the evidence pack documents no such capability. The closest items are adjacent features. Runway Ads automatically iterates new ads around ad-spend performance, which is automated regeneration rather than insights shown to the user. The pack also mentions an 'agentic creative collaborator' with no stated data-insight function, and cost-visibility reporting, which is a dashboard rather than AI-generated suggestions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
